digest.component_or_area: CloudWatch alarm configuration and SNS notification wiring
propositions: rebar-gerrit-voter-errors and rebar-gerrit-replication-errors CloudWatch alarms declare no alarm_actions or ok_actions, causing alarm transitions to fire silently with no notifications sent to any subscriber.
The established repo convention across 11 of 13 aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm resources is to wire both alarm_actions and ok_actions to aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn; only these two alarms omit this wiring.
The voter_errors alarm is critical to the ADR-0013 review-bot gate that gates all landings on main, making its silent failure a production safety gap.

A regression guard test must parse all aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm blocks under infra/terraform/ and fail on any lacking alarm_actions, with anti-vacuity assertion (>= 13 alarms) and explicit documented opt-out marker requirement.

Terraform change landing is not applying; the alarms remain actionless in production until an operator runs terraform apply, leaving the ticket open until live describe-alarms confirms non-empty AlarmActions and a forced notification is observed end-to-end.
